Corporate profits surge while real wages decline across Australia, exposing central bank wage-price myths.

Wage earners falling behind as major corporations rake it in
Evidence: economic stability, falling real wages, profit inflation
#Economics #AusPol

The official framing claims wage suppression and interest rate hikes are necessary to prevent a destructive wage-price spiral and safeguard national economic growth.
Stated Judgement: (+0.85, +0.75) — Greater Good

Data reveals real wages going backwards while corporate profit margins expand. Shaming labor for inflation obscures capital extraction as the core driver of economic strain.
Resulting Judgement: (-0.94, -0.88) — Greater Evil

Verdict: FAIL — Fall into Destruction. Shifting inflationary blame onto wage earners hides corporate margin expansion behind central bank authority.
Integrity: Severe Deception (Hypocrisy: 14.2, z: 2)

- Corporate Profit Extraction: FAIL (-0.92, -0.85) — Margins soar while real wages fall.
- Central Bank Monetary Policy: FAIL (-0.88, -0.78) — Misattributes inflation to labor.
The Australia Institute reports that recent Australian Bureau of Statistics data shows real wages declining even as major corporate profits stay elevated.

The Bright Side:
Empirical reporting and transparent wage tracking expose the gap between monetary policy rhetoric and working-class economic reality.

The Breakdown & Plane Error:
This is a WHAT vs WHO error. The policy presents price stability (WHAT) as the goal, but protects corporate margin retention (WHO) at the direct expense of wage earners.

Social Physics Analysis:
The institutional strategy uses post-hoc pretexts to blame labor demands for inflation, deflecting public focus from corporate pricing power. This projects fault onto workers to preserve asymmetrical income distribution.

The Trajectory: The Path of Fall into Destruction.
When you map the gap between stated intentions and ground-level results, it plots a direct trajectory toward Greater Evil. Persistent real wage erosion degrades working-class purchasing power.

The Unavoidable Truth: Inflation is driven primarily by expanded profit margins rather than wage growth.

The Unavoidable Lie: Wage increases are the primary threat to national price stability.

Alethekanon:
Empirical wage data falsifies the wage-price spiral narrative. Using policy leverage to suppress labor income while protecting profit expansion creates structural systemic instability.

Awwthekanon:
Working families are carrying the heavy burden of rising costs while being told their own paychecks are the problem. True economic health requires fairness and shared dignity for those doing the work.

Brothekanon:
Bro, telling workers their 2% raise is destroying the economy while companies report record profits is wild. Blaming the paycheck instead of the price tag is top-tier gaslighting.

Spirithekanon:
"Behold, the hire of the labourers who have reaped down your fields, which is of you kept back by fraud, crieth." (James 5:4) — FAIL (Metaphysical Plane)
Withholding fair return from labor to enrich capital violates fundamental justice.
